title: #63 Mark Deduction
prompt: Some universities deduct marks from students' work if it is handed in late. What is your opinion? What other actions do you recommend?

promptSegments.text: Some universities deduct marks from students' work if it is handed in late.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The essay argues that universities should deduct marks for late assignments by focusing on two main areas: maintaining academic standards and helping staff manage their workload.

angles.en: The structure follows the required PEEL format for both body paragraphs, ensuring each point is explained, exemplified, affected, and linked back to the main argument.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The argument against mark deductions focuses on the fact that late submissions are often symptoms of personal difficulties, suggesting a need for empathy over strict punishment.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The argument against mark deductions focuses on the fact that late submissions are often symptoms of personal difficulties, suggesting a need for empathy over strict punishment.
